definition: a long hollow pipe for liquids or gases
description: A plastic storage box on a wooden floor is filled to the top with pink packing peanuts, and a ferret is digging in the middle of it with only its head showing. Pink peanuts lie scattered all over the floor. A long grey ribbed tube lies bent in a loop on the floor next to the box. Ferrets jump out of the box, run across the wooden floor, dive into one end of the tube and pop out of the other, while another ferret keeps swimming through the peanuts in the box.

taps.phrase: to look out of a box
